An '''unidentified Zabrak''' was a member of the [[Nightbrothers/Legends|Nightbrothers]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
This [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] was one of the many brought forward by [[Viscus/Legends|Brother Viscus]] to appear in front of [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] for her selection of capable potential candidates to aid in her plan to get revenge against [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]]. This Zabrak was eliminated because Ventress believed he was only good looking, but not strong enough, so she [[Telekinesis/Legends#Force Choke|Force choked]] him into falling to his knees.<ref name="monster" />
